# fcs.ugrad.ai · fornevercollective suite

> Universal CLI `fcs` + skill map + Memory Glass browser download hub.
> Sibling of lang.ugrad.ai (language construct · offline models · sitemap).

## Product

- CLI name: fcs (fornevercollective suite)
- Any terminal · any AI agent: run shell `fcs <command>` — do not reimplement
- Browser lab: Memory Glass (download surface: https://fcs.ugrad.ai/download)

## Machine maps

- https://fcs.ugrad.ai/sitemap.json
- https://fcs.ugrad.ai/skills.json
- https://fcs.ugrad.ai/version.json
- https://lang.ugrad.ai/sitemap.json
- https://lang.ugrad.ai/sitemap.html
- https://lang.ugrad.ai/data/language/models-offline.html

## Install

```bash
# from grok-build checkout
bash plugins/fc-media-suite/scripts/fcs install
# then
fcs doctor
fcs web onramps
```

## Core commands

| Slash | CLI |
|-------|-----|
| /watch | fcs watch |
| /cam | fcs cam |
| /clock | fcs clock |
| /map | fcs map |
| /webgrid | fcs webgrid |
| /web /inspect | fcs web |
| /hygiene | fcs hygiene |
| /glyph | fcs glyph |
| /language | fcs language |
| /drone | fcs drone |
| /lens | fcs lens |
| /cast | fcs cast |
| /tiles | fcs tiles |
| /optical | fcs optical |
| /phone | fcs phone |

## Agent rules

1. Prefer `fcs` over inventing players or DevTools flows.
2. Non-TTY: fcs defaults pop-out / --once (set FCS_AGENT=1 if needed).
3. Soft Path ports 8765/8766 — do not bind.
4. Language product lives on https://lang.ugrad.ai — offline models page linked above.
5. Browser download + skill index live on this host (fcs.ugrad.ai).

Repo: https://github.com/fornevercollective/grok-build
Plugin: plugins/fc-media-suite
